rics.description: Core PCE prices-adv - Actual, Chg P/P
rics.meaning: Month-over-month change in Core PCE — most market-relevant when annualized over 3 or 6 months. Above ~0.17%/mo is hawkish for rates.
rics.how_to_use: THE Fed inflation series. The 6-month annualized core PCE is what FOMC commentary typically references. Released ~2 weeks after CPI with the BEA Personal Income & Outlays report. Lower than CPI because of basket weighting (less shelter weight) and chain-weighting.

rics.description: GDP deflator-adv - Actual, Chg P/P
rics.meaning: Month-over-month percentage change in the GDP deflator (implicit price index for GDP).
rics.how_to_use: Broader than CPI/PCE — covers all final domestic production. Differs because it's chain-weighted and excludes imports. Useful for cross-country GDP-deflator comparison and for converting nominal to real GDP.

rics.description: IPRCD, Exports
rics.meaning: Level of US exports.
rics.how_to_use: Largest categories: capital goods, services (financial, IP, travel), industrial supplies. Services exports persistently surplus. Strong USD compresses receipts in local-currency-equivalent terms.

rics.description: IPRCD, Exports, Goods
rics.meaning: Level of US exports.
rics.how_to_use: Largest categories: capital goods, services (financial, IP, travel), industrial supplies. Services exports persistently surplus. Strong USD compresses receipts in local-currency-equivalent terms.

rics.description: IPRCD, Federal government consumption & investment
rics.meaning: Level of the government spending component of US GDP.
rics.how_to_use: Less cyclical than private components. Direct fiscal-stimulus channel. Federal vs state-and-local mix matters: states are pro-cyclical (balanced-budget constraints), federal is counter-cyclical.

rics.description: IPRCD, Fixed investment, Non-residential
rics.meaning: Level of the private investment component of US GDP.
rics.how_to_use: Drives productivity growth long-term and is highly cyclical short-term. Residential investment leads recessions; nonresidential structures and equipment lag. AI capex surge is reshaping intellectual-property investment.

rics.how_to_use: Largest categories: consumer goods, capital goods, autos, industrial supplies. Goods imports cycle with US demand; services imports steadier. Watch country shares (especially China — tariff overlay).
